about_the_game:
All that remains of the once-glorious dwarven civilization is dust, scattered exiles, and monster-infested landscapes. Embark on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure as a lone dwarf attempting to re-establish a haven for your dwarven kin - and delve into the mysteries of their forebears.

 

In the Regions of Ruin: Runegate demo, you will explore the first hour and world of the game, discovering varied points of interest in pursuit of resources, fellow dwarves to help and enemies to vanquish. Return to your dwarven Sanctuary to restore buildings and manage workers, taking your first steps to creating a haven for your brethren.

 

In the demo, you will be able to:

  • Visit over 30 points of interests, consisting of caves, villages, camps, forests, ruins and fields

  • Find your weapon of choice from an arsenal of weapons: knives, swords, axes, polearms, warhammers, spears, crossbows, and more.

  • Fight goblins, humans, orcs, and more in the pursuit of resources and equipment

  • Help your fellow dwarves and other denizens of Otam in desperate need of assistance

  • Gather food, wood, rock, ore, leather and silk to upgrade various buildings in your Sanctuary

  • Restore the Blacksmith, Marketplace, Great Hall, bridges and more in your Sanctuary

  • Recruit unique companions from the world to fight by your side in battle
